name: Pseudocolor
description: Maps the luma of the picture to a color palette (magma, viridis, turbo...) or marks luma ranges.

params.name: preset
params.description: Preset: -1 = none (unchanged), 0 = magma, 1 = inferno, 2 = plasma, 3 = viridis, 4 = turbo, 5 = cividis, 6 = range1, 7 = range2, 8 = shadows, 9 = highlights, 10 = solar, 11 = nominal, 12 = preferred, 13 = total, 14 = spectral, 15 = cool, 16 = heat, 17 = fiery, 18 = blues, 19 = green, 20 = helix

params.name: opacity
params.description: Opacity of the false color over the picture
